operations.title: Gram Degeneracy Changes the Branch-Support Mechanism
Gram-degenerate Kummer support is governed by affine rank consistency and a restricted quadratic
operations.summary: On detG=0 the cleared adjugate numerator is not the complete support condition. One must first solve A ell=d/2 and then restrict ell^2 to that affine solution locus. A consistent rank-two locus generically gives two complex fourfold branch points; a transverse fifth point imposes one further external equation.

operations.title: Exact rank-aware Gram-degenerate branch audit
operations.summary: Dependency-free rational checker verifies a consistent rank-two example with restricted polynomial z^2+1/2, transverse fifth-point condition s^2+2, and an inconsistent rank-one control.
